summary: Frontend-only regression on Quotations (Tour&Travel+Umrah CRM). Verified: (1) New/Edit Quotation dialog shows 'Tipe Diskon' (data-testid quot-discount-type) with Persen/Nominal options and label switches (% vs Rp) on quot-discount-input; (2) Saved AMOUNT quotation with Rp 5.000.000 and PERCENT with 4% — table shows 'diskon Rp 5.000.000' and 'diskon 4%' respectively; (3) RBAC: as Sales (sales@safarcrm.com), no quot-accept/quot-approve/quot-reject buttons rendered on any row, only quot-edit (4 rows) and PDF/convert where applicable; (4) RBAC: as Super Admin (dedyirawan18@gmail.com), quot-accept buttons appear for DRAFT/APPROVED rows (4 rows) and clicking Accept produced toast 'Quotation accepted' and status flipped to ACCEPTED; (5) Convert works — clicking quot-convert on an ACCEPTED row produced toast 'Dikonversi ke booking'; (6) Edit dialog for Super Admin allows changing discount_type to Nominal (Rp) with value 1.500.000, Update persists (toast 'Quotation diperbarui', row shows updated 'diskon Rp 1.500.000'). Approve/Reject buttons did not appear because all created discounts (4% and 5M≈5%) auto-approved under sales_max_percent=5% — expected per review notes.
critical_code_review_comments: Quotations.jsx is around 150+ lines and contains dialog + table + row actions inline; consider extracting QuotationDialog and QuotationRowActions for maintainability, but no bug.
Discount cell text uses q.discount_percent for percent display; ensure backend always returns discount_percent when type=AMOUNT for edit re-open (observed working).
